claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 7.1–7.7 g/dL) in the setting of critical illness and cardiac output monitoring.
Obtain type and screen/crossmatch to support blood product transfusion.
Recheck hemoglobin/hematocrit after transfusion to assess response.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor airway pressures, tidal volumes, and minute ventilation.
Wean inspired oxygen fraction from 70% as tolerated, targeting SpO2 above the documented desaturation limit, with repeat arterial blood gas assessment.
Continue nicardipine infusion and titrate to maintain blood pressure within the documented alarm parameters (systolic 90–140 mmHg).
Replete potassium given whole-blood potassium 3.2–3.6 mEq/L and serum potassium 3.4 mEq/L.
Recheck basic metabolic panel including potassium, sodium, and ionized calcium after repletion.
Continue temporary pacemaker with atrial and ventricular wires and monitor sensing/stimulation thresholds and underlying rhythm.
Monitor invasive hemodynamics via pulmonary artery catheter and arterial line, including cardiac output, pulmonary artery pressures, and central venous pressure.
